---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for MediQueue
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / Motivation

Describe the problem this feature solves, or the user need it addresses. Why does this matter for a healthcare queue or health-vault workflow?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Are there simpler workarounds? Why is this the right approach?

## Implementation Notes (optional)

- Which controllers, models, or services would be affected?
- Any API changes needed (new routes, request/response shape)?
- Frontend pages or components involved?
- Does this touch auth, encryption, consent, or audit logs? (those need extra care)

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, diagrams, or references that would help clarify the feature.
